meta.note: Five-year India Standard Time reference (2026–2030), including Adhika months in 2026 and 2028. Published panchang dates are stored in the app; Parana is recalculated from the chosen city's sunrise. Distant cities may shift the fasting day by a day. Confirm with a local panchang before breaking the fast.

ekadashis.name: Shattila
ekadashis.significance: Marked by charity involving sesame (til) in six ways.

ekadashis.name: Jaya
ekadashis.significance: Said to free devotees from the fate of becoming ghosts.

ekadashis.name: Vijaya
ekadashis.significance: Associated with victory; observed by Lord Rama before crossing to Lanka.

ekadashis.name: Amalaki
ekadashis.significance: Honours the amalaki (Indian gooseberry) tree, sacred to Vishnu.

ekadashis.name: Papmochani
ekadashis.significance: Believed to wash away accumulated sins (papa).

ekadashis.name: Kamada
ekadashis.significance: The fulfiller of desires; first Ekadashi of the lunar new year in many panchangs.

ekadashis.name: Varuthini
ekadashis.significance: Grants protection and material as well as spiritual prosperity.

ekadashis.name: Mohini
ekadashis.significance: Named after Vishnu's Mohini avatar; frees one from illusion (moha).

ekadashis.name: Apara
ekadashis.significance: Bestows boundless (apara) merit and reputation.

ekadashis.name: Padmini
ekadashis.significance: Rare Adhika-masa Ekadashi of Purushottama month, observed only in leap-lunar years.

ekadashis.name: Parama
ekadashis.significance: The Krishna-paksha Ekadashi of Adhika Jyeshtha (Purushottama masa).

ekadashis.name: Nirjala
ekadashis.significance: The strictest fast, kept without water (nir-jala).

ekadashis.name: Yogini
ekadashis.significance: Observed to cure ailments and remove sins.

ekadashis.name: Devshayani
ekadashis.significance: Marks the start of Chaturmas, when Vishnu is said to rest.

ekadashis.name: Kamika
ekadashis.significance: Worship of Vishnu with tulsi leaves brings great merit.

ekadashis.name: Shravana Putrada
ekadashis.significance: Observed by couples seeking the blessing of children.

ekadashis.name: Aja
ekadashis.significance: Relieves suffering and restores lost fortune.

ekadashis.name: Parsva
ekadashis.significance: Also called Parivartini; Vishnu turns to his other side in yogic sleep.

ekadashis.name: Indira
ekadashis.significance: Observed to liberate one's ancestors (pitrs).

ekadashis.name: Papankusha
ekadashis.significance: Acts as a goad (ankusha) that keeps sin away.

ekadashis.name: Rama
ekadashis.significance: Precedes Diwali; grants prosperity and devotion.

ekadashis.name: Devutthana
ekadashis.significance: Also Prabodhini; Vishnu awakens, ending Chaturmas.

ekadashis.name: Utpanna
ekadashis.significance: Celebrates the origin (utpanna) of the goddess Ekadashi.

ekadashis.name: Saphala
